_note: Three branches: Saver (power), Giver (heart), Wise Spender (wisdom — the only source of Wisdom; gear never grants it). Skills change in-game stats only, never real money. One skill point is earned per hero level. 'icon' is a distinct emoji per skill, never reused across any item or skill.

skills.name: Steady Saver
skills.description: Saving a little, often, beats saving a lot, rarely.

skills.name: Rainy Day Ready
skills.description: Being prepared is its own kind of strength.

skills.name: Compound Thinker
skills.description: Patience turns small savings into big ones.

skills.name: Open Hands
skills.description: Giving doesn't have to wait until you have 'enough'.

skills.name: Generous Habit
skills.description: Giving regularly builds a generous heart.

skills.name: Legacy Giver
skills.description: What you give can outlast you.

skills.name: Pause Button
skills.description: A pause before spending is a planning superpower.

skills.name: Needs First
skills.description: Needs before wants keeps plans on track.

skills.name: Plan Ahead
skills.description: The best spending decisions are made before you're at the register.
